baseline.queries_unit: (document, attribute) pairs, each ranked with three query kinds

gate.against: a second sanad_hf call in this process
gate.rule: Two separate sanad_hf calls with the same embedder: the same retrieval-set digest and query count, the lexical ranker mizan.sanad.engine.retrieve in both, and all 27 lexical metrics (3 query kinds x 3 languages x 3 metrics) exactly equal. The E5 side is not gated; the first call's result is kept.

identity.note: manifest_sha256 is the SHA-256 of this machine's signed import (mizan-manifest.json, whose seal carries a local signature), while manifest_object is core.contract.digest of the signed manifest object (the pin and each file's SHA-256), reproducible by anyone re-importing the pin.

model.queries_unit: (document, attribute) pairs, each ranked with three query kinds

notes: The bilingual query is near its ceiling for the lexical retriever because the grammar only accepts lines beginning with the exact attribute label and the engine's bilingual query is exactly those labels, so the English-only and Arabic-only queries are the discriminating comparison.
Verdicts are not recomputed from either ranking: the grammar keeps verdict authority.

repeat_run.method: the whole evaluation of this system again in the same process, the model loaded again

determinism.applied_by: mizan.models._torch, called by every loader after the checkpoint is verified

settings.embedding: multilingual E5: 'query: ' and 'passage: ' prefixes, one padded batch per call, truncation at 256 tokens, mean pooling over the attention mask, L2-normalised; ranked by cosine, ties in document order
settings.protocol: Generated retrieval set: seeded single-page datasheets, alternately English and Arabic, each a model heading, then three to five scored attribute lines (each attribute at most once, grammar-valid values, Arabic-Indic digits in Arabic) and four to six near-miss lines from a fixed distractor pool per language, shuffled together. Gold is the line sanad.engine.parse_document extracts as the claim for each attribute; the generator stops (RETRIEVAL_SET) unless every attribute line is that claim and no other line is any claim. Each attribute is asked three ways: bilingual (English and Arabic labels joined, as assess builds its query), English label only and Arabic label only. Both retrievers rank every line of the document, the heading included. Lexical: sanad.engine.retrieve, unchanged (character-trigram TF-IDF), which returns its top four. Embedding: cosine between 'query: ' and 'passage: ' vectors, each document's lines encoded in one call and all queries in one call; ties keep document order, as the stable sort in retrieve does. Recall@1, recall@3 and MRR@4 (reciprocal rank 0 beyond rank four, where the engine stops). Verdicts are not recomputed from any ranking: the grammar keeps verdict authority.
settings.queries: (document, attribute) pairs, each ranked with three query kinds
